question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: The original torch of the Statue of Liberty was constructed in 1876 but later replaced in 1984 by a copper one covered in 24K (a) ------- leaf. It is now lighted at night using floodlights, while the original torch is kept in the (b) ------- of the monument. For safety reasons, access to the torch has been restricted since 1916. On her 125th anniversary in 2011, the statue was connected to the Internet through several (c) ------- placed around the torch. These allow users to enjoy amazing views with a click of the (d) -------. Some cameras offer wide-angle shots of the torch, while one looks down at the crown and face of the statue. People from anywhere can watch live using a computer or (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) gold; (b) lobby; (c) webcams; (d) mouse; (e) smartphone;
